title: LCB26 B3LYP/6-31+G* analytic harmonic comparison
summary: Optimize the frozen LINK-XTB corpus with GDV-detected symmetry and compute analytic B3LYP/6-31+G* Cartesian Hessians for an independent scaling comparison.
gates: GDV detects and follows molecular symmetry; NoSymm and forced point groups are forbidden
two threads and 8 GB per authorized job
at most four concurrent jobs on MAC-STUDIO
normal termination and one analytic Cartesian Hessian
Hessian-derived and printed harmonic frequencies agree within importer tolerance
optimized geometry and Hessian are rigidly aligned to the immutable LCB26 frame
coordinate_policy: Preserve atom order and let GDV construct symmetry-adapted native optimization coordinates; rotate the final geometry and Hessian to the parent LCB26 frame without atom remapping.
backend_policy: KeyMaker alone authorizes and routes native GDV B3LYP/6-31+G* Opt+Freq. NoSymm, forced point groups, and direct backend launch are forbidden.
